title: Govern
subtitle: Review platform drafts, set autonomy posture, and manage how agent changes apply.

drafts.empty: No pending platform changes. Agents can propose edits from the AI OS canvas or workforce tools.
drafts.acceptConfirm: Apply this change to your workspace?
drafts.rejectConfirm: Reject this change? It will not be applied.

posture.title: Autonomy posture
posture.intro: Choose how much AI can run without human review. You can fine-tune individual tool categories below.

manual.label: Manual
manual.summary: Humans approve every mutating agent action before it applies.

assisted.label: Assisted
assisted.summary: Routine messaging and workspace edits run automatically; structural changes ask first.

autonomous.label: Autonomous
autonomous.summary: AI runs operations; integrations and credentials still ask a human.

allowances.title: Allowance sliders
allowances.intro: Per tool category: deny blocks the action, ask creates an inline decision, allow runs it automatically with an audit record.

tokens.title: API tokens (MCP access)
tokens.intro: Connect Cursor or other MCP clients to this workspace at /api/mcp. Tokens use the same governed tools and allowance sliders as internal agents.
